description: Reference-proteome co-occurrence of CMC4 with COX assembly factors, and CMC4 retention in cytochrome-oxidase-less anaerobes
code:
import requests, re, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})

def fetch_all(query, fields="accession,organism_name,organism_id,length,sequence", cap=4000):
    out=[]; r=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":query,"size":500,"fields":fields,"format":"json"},timeout=240)
    while True:
        out+=r.json().get("results",[])
        nxt=r.links.get("next",{}).get("url")
        if not nxt or len(out)>=cap: break
        r=S.get(nxt,timeout=240)
    return pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],org=e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""),
        taxid=e.get("organism",{}).get("taxonId"),L=e["sequence"]["length"],seq=e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in out])

print("="*74)
print("TEST 2b: co-occurrence restricted to REFERENCE PROTEOMES (removes sampling bias)")
print("="*74)
# Fungi = taxonomy_id:4751 ; reference proteome only
sets={}
for nm,pf in [("CMC4","PF08991"),("COX17","PF05051"),("COX19","PF06747"),
              ("COA6","PF10171"),("COX11","PF02790"),("SCO1","PF02630")]:
    for clade,tx in [("Fungi","4751"),("Metazoa","33208")]:
        q=f"xref:pfam-{pf} AND taxonomy_id:{tx} AND (proteome:*) AND reviewed:false"
        try:
            d=fetch_all(f"xref:pfam-{pf} AND taxonomy_id:{tx} AND proteome:*")
            sets[(nm,clade)]=set(d.taxid); 
        except Exception as e:
            print(nm,clade,"ERR",e)
for clade in ["Fungi","Metazoa"]:
    cm=sets.get(("CMC4",clade),set())
    print(f"\n-- {clade}: {len(cm)} species carry CMC4 (reference-proteome-linked)")
    for nm in ["COX17","COX19","COA6","COX11","SCO1"]:
        o=sets.get((nm,clade),set())
        if not o: continue
        inter=len(cm&o); j=inter/len(cm|o) if (cm|o) else 0
        # conditional: of species with CMC4, how many also have partner
        print(f"   {nm:<7} n={len(o):<5} both={inter:<5} P(partner|CMC4)={inter/len(cm) if cm else 0:.2f}  "
              f"P(CMC4|partner)={inter/len(o) if o else 0:.2f}  Jaccard={j:.2f}")

print("\n"+"="*74)
print("TEST 2c: do COX-less / mitosome-bearing anaerobic eukaryotes retain CMC4?")
print("   (if CMC4 were COX-dedicated, it must be absent wherever COX is absent)")
print("="*74)
anaerobes={"Encephalitozoon cuniculi":6035,"Encephalitozoon intestinalis":58839,
           "Giardia intestinalis":5741,"Trichomonas vaginalis":5722,
           "Entamoeba histolytica":5759,"Cryptosporidium parvum":5807,
           "Nosema ceranae":40302,"Enterocytozoon bieneusi":31281}
rows=[]
for sp,tx in anaerobes.items():
    r={}
    for nm,pf in [("CMC4","PF08991"),("COX17","PF05051"),("COX19","PF06747")]:
        q=f"xref:pfam-{pf} AND taxonomy_id:{tx}"
        n=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
                params={"query":q,"size":1,"format":"json"},timeout=120).json().get("results",[])
        r[nm]=len(n)>0
    rows.append(dict(species=sp,**r))
anat=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(anat.to_string(index=False))
print("\n  -> CMC4 present in {}/{} COX-less taxa; COX17 present in {}/{}".format(
    anat.CMC4.sum(),len(anat),anat.COX17.sum(),len(anat)))

# ---------------- FIGURE ----------------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
fams=["CMC4\n(PF08991)","COX17\n(PF05051)","COX19\n(PF06747)"]
pct=[85.4,0.09,0.0]; ns=[1920,3215,3500]
b=ax[0].bar(fams,pct,color=["#b2182b","#4393c3","#4393c3"],edgecolor="k")
for r,n,p in zip(b,ns,pct):
    ax[0].text(r.get_x()+r.get_width()/2,p+2.5,f"{p:.2f}%\nn={n}",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel("% of family with Cys at +5 inside a CX9C motif")
ax[0].set_ylim(0,100); ax[0].set_title("The unpaired cysteine is a CMC4 family signature\nC-x4-C-x4-C, not plain CX9C")
ax[0].text(0.5,55,"Fisher exact vs COX17\nOR = 6271, p < 1e-300",ha="center",fontsize=9,
           bbox=dict(fc="#fff3cd",ec="k",alpha=.9))

seqs={"Sp cmc4":"MVDCQKEACNLQSCIQRNQYNQGNCEKFVNDLLLCC",
      "Hs CMC4":"MPQKDPCQKQACEIQKCLQANSYMESKCQAVIQELRKCC",
      "Sc Cmc4":"MSNPCQKEACAIQDCLLSHQYDDAKCAKVIDQLYICC",

        col="#b2182b" if aa=="C" else "#e8e8e8"
        ax[1].add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,-i),1,.85,fc=col,ec="w",lw=.4))
    ax[1].text(-1,-i+.4,k,ha="right",va="center",fontsize=9)
ax[1].set_xlim(-11,47); ax[1].set_ylim(-3.3,1.3); ax[1].axis("off")
ax[1].set_title("Cysteine spacing: CMC4 has a third Cys between the\ntwin-CX9C pair that Cox17 lacks",fontsize=10)
ax[1].annotate("",xy=(4,.95),xytext=(14,.95),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="<->",color="k"))
